client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and others) - the server needs no custom
client, no proprietary transport, and no approval extension.
Place the contents of `mcpServers` into your client's MCP configuration file.
Credentials come from the environment; mint a refresh token with
Start with version: 1 and accounts.allowedCustomerIds as ten-digit operator customer IDs.
Set mutations.enabled: true and mutations.default: deny; enable only chosen mutations.tools.
